sources.title: First commercially available mobile phone — Guinness World Records

summary_zh: 1973 年摩托罗拉马丁·库珀在纽约用原型机打出首个公开手持蜂窝电话；1983 年 DynaTAC 8000X 成为第一款商用手持手机，俗称「砖头机」。
summary_en: Motorola’s Martin Cooper made a public handheld cellular call in New York in 1973. In 1983 the DynaTAC 8000X became the first commercial handheld cellphone, nicknamed “the brick.”
